subtopic: Diversification with Mutual Funds and ETFs
source_evidence: These funds make it easy for investors to own a small portion of many investments.
answer: Mutual funds and ETFs pool money from many investors and invest it in assets such as stocks and bonds. This can make it easier to spread your investment across many holdings. However, owning a fund does not automatically mean you are diversified: a fund focused narrowly on one industry may offer limited diversification. If you hold multiple funds, check their top holdings to see whether they are different and provide the diversification you want.
